sections.title: Types of exercise
sections.content:
Advanced vocabulary for fitness and physical activity:
• endurance — the ability to sustain effort. Marathon running requires tremendous endurance.
• stamina — physical or mental staying power. Building stamina takes weeks of consistent training.
• agility — ability to move quickly and easily. Football players need both speed and agility.
• intensity — the degree of effort in exercise. High-intensity interval training burns fat effectively.
• regime — a planned system of exercise. She follows a strict training regime.

sections.title: Competition and performance
sections.content:
Words for competitive situations:
• opponent — the person you compete against. She defeated a much more experienced opponent.
• spectator — someone who watches an event. Over 80,000 spectators filled the stadium.
• underdog — the team expected to lose. The underdog won the championship in a dramatic final.
• sportsmanship — fair and generous behaviour. Good sportsmanship is as important as winning.
• disqualified — removed from a competition for breaking rules. The athlete was disqualified for using banned substances.

exercises.question: The ability to keep going during long physical effort is:
exercises.explanation: Endurance is the ability to sustain prolonged physical effort.

exercises.question: A competitor expected to lose is called the:
exercises.explanation: An underdog is a competitor thought to have little chance of winning.

exercises.question: Fair, ethical behaviour in competition is:
exercises.hint: Playing by the rules with grace.
exercises.explanation: Sportsmanship is fair and generous behaviour in sport.

exercises.question: The degree of effort you put into exercise is its:
exercises.explanation: Intensity is the level of effort applied during exercise.

exercises.question: Being removed from a competition for rule-breaking is being:
exercises.explanation: Disqualified means removed from a competition for violating rules.

exercises.question: Quick, nimble movement ability is:
exercises.explanation: Agility is the ability to move quickly and easily.

exercises.question: A planned system of training is a:
exercises.explanation: A regime is a systematic plan, especially of exercise.

exercises.question: Someone watching a sports event is a:
exercises.explanation: A spectator is a person who watches an event.
